label: sdc02_0040_headbb_01
text: Ta-daaa! We’re here![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_02
text: Welcome to my grand Blueberry Academy![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_03
text: This is actually just the entrance—the school itself\nis mostly underwater! Isn’t that amazing?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_04
text: Oh—and did you notice?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_05
text: Look at how blue the place is! I can’t tell you how\nlong I spent picking the perfect blueberry color![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_06
text: Let’s see... What else?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_07
text: Uh...perhaps you have something you’d like to\nask me?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_select_01
text: Why’s the rest of the school underwater?

label: sdc02_0040_select_02
text: Why did you pick “blueberry” for the name?

label: sdc02_0040_select_03
text: How do you know Director Clavell?

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_08
text: Really? That’s what you’re curious about?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_09
text: Well, it’s very simple. You see, it’s...uh...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_01
text: It’s because the school building is attached to an\nundersea plant that develops natural resources.\r\nRight? That’s what I’ve heard![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_02
text: It’s because, in the language of flowers, the\nblueberry is said to represent a fruitful life.\r\nI think that’s where it came from, right?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_03
text:
Director Cyrano and Director Clavell got to know
each other through their postgraduate work at
the same university.\c
Or at least that’s what I’ve heard![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_10
text: Yes! Right! Exactly! Took the words right out of\nmy mouth.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_11
text: Always on point, aren’t you, Lacey?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_04
text: Oh, no, it was nothing...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_05
text: Do we have a guest today?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_12
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]We do! [VAR 0x0100(0000)] is here as
part
of
the
exchange
program.
Make
h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer
feel
welcome, eh?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_06
text: Hold on—this is the exchange student from the\nPaldea region?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_07
text: I suppose I didn’t introduce myself, did I?\nI’m Lacey—one of the second-year students here![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_08
text: You must really be something special, you know.\c\nIt’s rare for Director Cyrano to remember the\nname of a new student.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_13
text: Hah! Just call me out, why don’t you![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_14
text: Actually, I’ve got an idea! Why don’t YOU explain\nhow things work around here, Lacey?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_09
text: You...you want ME to do it?![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_15
text: Well, yeah. You know this tour-guide stuff isn’t\nmy strong suit![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_10
text: Well, that’s certainly true... But still, I imagine\nthere must be someone more suitable than me.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_11
text: Oh! Please, don’t take it like— It’s not that I\ndon’t want to show you around or anything![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_12
text: Director Cyrano just has this bad habit of pushing\nhis duties onto me, you see.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_13
text: And it’s just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_16
text: Really letting me have it today, aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_14
text: That said...this might be my chance to get to\nknow the new student everyone’s talking about\r\nbefore anyone else can...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_15
text: That decides it! I will take on this task![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_17
text: Excellent![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_16
text: Now then, let’s head straight down this bridge\nand to the entrance! On you go![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_headbb_18
text: You can get a gorgeous view of the sunset from\nthis walkway, you know![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: sdc02_0040_fairybb_17
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Just head straight to the entrance,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0040_reception_npc
text: Welcome to Blueberry Academy!\c\nYou can get to the school facilities using the\ngates on either side of this desk.
